BAHA SA PACO

Floodwaters rose in Barangay 828, Paco, Manila early on the midnight of 10 November 2025 as Typhoon #UwanPH affected the area. Residents were advised to park their vehicles and motorcycles in the court area, and Roxas High School was opened as an evacuation center. | Patricia Ramirez @tribunephl_pr / Photos courtesy of SK Barangay 828 Zone 89 on Facebook
